description.narrative: Contract related to: EU POP In Canada III - The proposed Public Diplomacy action ¿EU Policy and Outreach Partnership in Canada III¿ aims to continue building trust and mutual understanding between the EU and Canadian citizens by engaging with key target audiences, stakeholders and partners in order to enhance the understanding of the EU in Canada, consolidate the perception of the EU as a relevant partner for the Canadian people and ultimately facilitate future cooperation across policy areas. To do so the action will implement long-term engagement initiatives reinforcing people-to-people contacts, foster relevant networks and exchanges among opinion leaders, decision makers, influencers, multipliers, think tanks, academia, youth & students, media, civil society, business organisations, the cultural sector and other relevant partners and stakeholders at the federal, provincial and local level. The action will reinforce the capacity of the EU Delegation in Canada to develop long-term engagement strategies with key target audiences and partners and build and mobilise alliances across priority areas.
